title: Framer site showcase
description: A one-line title with a small button at its right over two rows of tall rounded site shots, wide landscape tiles mixed with narrow phone-shaped ones, cropped at the column edges. As the page scrolls the two rows drift sideways in opposite directions.
notes: tiles are media slots: landscape 700×450 and portrait 220×450 (404×260 / 127×260 on phones)
the drift is a CSS scroll-driven animation (80px each way); without support or with reduced motion the rows stay put
